value.title: Coder packet — u-a worktree lifecycle detector

sections.name: mission
sections.value: You own u-a, ONE unit of plan 006-worktree-diff: the worktree LIFECYCLE DETECTOR. Today fs3 never notices that a git worktree of a registered repo appeared, and never notices that one vanished — both measured, see the probe report. Everything downstream already works: `add` scans a worktree for zero provider spend when its content matches main (305 files, 0 elements, 0 summaries, 0 vectors, 0 provider round trips), and `remove` + `gc` dereference and reclaim it cleanly with zero orphaned paid enrichment (149 elements + 8 vectors reclaimed). You are building the DETECTOR, not the mechanism: one reconcile pass that diffs the live worktrees of registered repos against the `worktrees` table and drives the EXISTING roots.rs verbs at both ends.

value.text: Orient: read your unit's row in the impl-guide (impl-guide.dd.json), the plan phase/tasks you own, and the interface contract. Run `harness boot --json` in your worktree before changing anything. DOGFOOD FLOWSPACE: `flowspace3 search "<question>"` for every meaning-shaped question before grep (exact identifiers may still grep); report every miss or confusing envelope as friction.
Ack FIRST: reply to the PM with your read of the unit + a numbered implementation plan before writing code. Corrections to the packet are welcome — bring evidence.

Implement using the /builder implement discipline: work the tasks in order, keep the execution log honest, tests alongside code — your unit's test suite must prove the interface contract without the other units present.
Stay inside your unit's paths (scope below). If the work forces you outside them, STOP and ask the PM — that is a composition concern, not yours to solve unilaterally.
Commit with `harness commit` (conventional commits are binding), status card at start and end of each unit of work (`pij report now`).
Done = `harness checks` green in YOUR worktree + your unit's tests proving the contract. Report done to the PM with the evidence, then hold for composition questions — do not merge anything.
Capture friction with `harness observe` the moment it bites; list, never clear the buffer.

READ FIRST, in this order: docs/plans/006-worktree-diff/assets/probe-report.md (the evidence contract your unit exists to close — P1 and P4), docs/services/watcher.md (the reconcile-don't-react doctrine and `diff_roots`, which is the idiom you are copying), docs/services/remove-and-gc.md (why removal must never cascade into re-payable spend), and .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md.

THE DESIGN, settled — fill this contract, do not widen it. A `Reconcile` implementor (same trait `WatcherSupervisor` and `GcSupervisor` use) in crates/daemon/src/worktrees.rs, registered in the boot.rs roster with ONE line. Each pass: enumerate the live git worktrees of every registered repo, diff against the `worktrees` table, then (a) for each that appeared, drive the EXISTING registration+scan path; (b) for each whose directory is gone, drive the EXISTING remove path. Reclamation stays GC's on GC's cadence — you never delete content, and you never invent a second reference mechanism beside roots.rs (plan risk r2, and the review will look for it by name).

PRIME'S RIDER, binding on your done bar: the detector may pay O(files) on the FIRST registration of a worktree, and must NOT re-emit that work on later passes for an unchanged worktree. Measured baseline: one 305-file registration emits 4,767 jobs, of which 4,462 are enrichment jobs that store nothing (free in spend, deliberate re-emission, but O(files)). Five live worktrees on this machine would mean ~24k no-op jobs per sweep. A diff-only pass gets this for free — but PROVE it, do not assert it: add one line to assets/probes/probe.sh that runs repeated passes over an unchanged registered worktree and records the jobs enqueued (expected: 0).

DONE IS MECHANICAL — the probe harness is your test. Re-running docs/plans/006-worktree-diff/assets/probes/probe.sh must flip `p1_auto_discovered` 0 -> 1 and `p4_root_still_registered` 1 -> 0 in receipt.env WITHOUT any manual CLI call, with `p4_served_after_gc` still 0 and your new no-op line reading 0. That is on top of, not instead of, standalone offline unit tests with fakes (mocking crates are refused by name in this repo) and `harness checks` green in your own worktree.

TEST CONSTRAINT (DL-002, binding): never assert on raw search scores. They carry float jitter across identical calls — 0.7730240968 vs 0.7730564295 for the same query seconds apart — and it already produced one phantom finding in phase 1. Compare result identity (address/path/name/kind/span) or rank order.

Your pij sends from this worktree need PIJ_SESSION_ID exported. Status card at start and end of the unit (`pij report now "<did>" "<next>"`). Report to the PM (pij-parliamentary-leopon), never to prime or Jordan.
The PM is your interface: acks, questions, done reports. You never message prime or Jordan directly unless the PM's seat is dead.
DEFER to the PM: interface changes (they affect sibling units), dependency additions, schema/migration changes, anything outside your paths.
Your evidence outranks the packet: if the brief is wrong, say so at ack or stop-and-ask with the measurement — do not silently code around it.

value.fence: YOURS: crates/daemon/src/worktrees.rs (new), crates/daemon/src/boot.rs (roster line only), crates/core/src/config.rs (one cadence/toggle knob), crates/daemon/tests/**, docs/services/<your service page>.md, docs/plans/006-worktree-diff/assets/probes/probe.sh (the ONE probe line proving the no-op bound). NOT YOURS: crates/daemon/src/search.rs and read.rs (u-c owns them, in a sibling worktree, right now), the reference/GC semantics in crates/store/src/roots.rs (call them, never redesign them).
value.forbidden_note: Never write .harness/government/**, another seat's worktree, or the pij-team skill folder. Never merge. Never `docker compose up` — the shared stack on :5433 is live and other seats are using it. Never add a dependency edge without PM approval (arch-allowlist rows are PM-granted). ABSOLUTE PATHS for every file read/edit (DL-007/008: seat file tools can resolve relatives against the spawn cwd — state your worktree root at ack). CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. A rustc-LLVM IO failure is disk, not code — report it, do not debug it, and put the free-space Avail figure in every report.

value.text: Unit implements the interface contract in the impl-guide row, verbatim or with PM-ruled amendments.
Unit test suite passes standalone and proves the contract.

harness checks green in your worktree — AND prove the change is IN THE TREE YOU BUILT, not just that the build exited 0: cite tree-resident evidence (the lockfile carries your dependency, mtime/git status shows your file, the artifact names your module). An exit code is honest about what it built and silent about what it did not.

The SNAP-IN RECIPE shipped with the unit (tenet 4): the exact wiring the composer will paste — config shape, construction call, registration line — as a doc comment or section in your unit's service page. You never wire it in yourself.

Done report to PM: what shipped, evidence, deviations, anything the composer must know — INCLUDING an explicit ASSUMPTIONS section: everything you assumed about the composition you do not own (who calls you, in what order, with what already in the store). A green gate proves your unit against YOUR assumptions; naming them is what lets the composer test them.
